title: CreditConsent
description: One applicant's explicit, auditable authorization for one credit_application_submit payload: to send the application to the dealer and its lenders, to obtain the named kind of credit inquiry, and to be contacted on the selected channels. Each applicant grants their own. A session, tool selection, OAuth authorization, PAP operation approval or lead consent is not credit consent. A malformed, expired or inapplicable grant returns INVALID_CONSENT.

granted_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp at which this applicant authorized the application. MUST include a timezone offset (Z or ±HH:MM).

consent_text.description: Verbatim text this applicant agreed to, including the credit-report authorization. MUST be non-empty: this is the audit trail of what the applicant actually saw.

authorized_inquiry.description: The credit inquiry this applicant authorized. soft: prequalification that does not affect the credit score. hard: a full application inquiry. The dealer and its lenders MUST NOT make a hard inquiry on a soft authorization.

allowed_channels.description: Channels this applicant authorized for follow-up about the application.

expires_at.description: Optional deadline for using this grant. When present it must follow granted_at; JSON Schema cannot compare the timestamps, so receivers check this and answer INVALID_CONSENT.
